newsitem.title: UK: Euro veg oils mostly close easier, little trade.
newsitem.headline: Euro veg oils mostly close easier, little trade.

text.p: European vegetable oils ended the morning mostly weaker after an easier Malaysian palm oil futures close and a mixed start to the the Chicago soybean oil futures.
News that Indonesia's state-run joint marketing agency KPB would resume signing crude palm oil export contracts in November after a freeze in October weakened the Malaysian market.
Business was subdued as traders awaited cargo surveyor SGS October 1-25 Malaysian palm oil export data.
No trade was reported on the palm oil sector during the afternoon.
Soy and rape oil fell in sympathy with the palm oil sector and recent losses on the Chicago soybean oil futures, although only one trade was noterd for Nov soy oil at 87 guilders.
Coconut oil and palmkernel oil ended $2.50 to $5 lower. Two trades were reported, Sep/Oct coconut oil at $725 and Dec palmkernel oil $685.
